summary: 'all students pay the same tuition fees regardless of nationality' closely mirrors the university's own sentence ('All students pay the same tuition fees – regardless of their nationality'). It is attributed, but consider rewording.

The international students page carries an unsourced superlative ('London's best university for international students'); the file does not repeat it.
